content.text:
The figure is in `/work/index.html`. It renders with no console errors. I checked the link between the views by temporarily selecting 2022–2024 in code (I didn't drag with a mouse): the circle highlighted just that range and dimmed everything else. That test code has been removed.

The answer to the question is **no**. Every season from 2012/13 to 2019/20 peaked in ISO weeks W5–W12 (February–March). From 2020/21 on, peaks range from W50 to W39, and 3 of 6 of them fall outside that earlier window. The caption states this, and its numbers are computed from the data.

**Layout:**
- **Left:** the circular view, one line per ISO year, with a triangle at each season's peak.
- **Top right:** the linear timeline. Drag to select a time range; hovering a year in the legend shows only that year.
- **Bottom right:** an extra strip showing the week of each season's peak.

```
REPORT
deliverable: index.html
requirements:
  R1: done - angle=(week-1)/weeksInIsoYear, W1 at 12 o'clock, clockwise; radius = incidence
  R2: done - one radial line per ISO year, sequential colour + legend (hover isolates a year)
  R3: done - triangle at max week per Saison in circle (also in linear view and a peak-week strip)
  R4: done - linear time series 2012–2026 on UTC calendar axis (Monday of ISO week)
  R5: done - d3.brushX on linear view highlights in-range weeks/peaks in circle, dims rest
  R6: done - week labels around circle, radial value ticks, dated x-axis, y-axis with unit
  R7: done - title + one-sentence caption, numbers computed from data
assumptions:
  - Week date = Monday of ISO week, computed from ISO year/week in Kalenderwoche
  - 53-week ISO years are spread over a full turn (angle uses that year's week count)
  - Season peak = week with max value within Saison; incomplete 2026/27 is marked and flagged "season incomplete"
  - Caption splits seasons into before/after 2020/21 (COVID onset); only complete seasons (≥52 weeks) are used
limitations:
  - 15 year lines overlap in the circle; colours of neighbouring years are hard to tell apart without the hover/brush
  - Year lines are not joined across W52/53→W1, so there is a small gap at 12 o'clock
  - Week tick labels are placed for a 52-week year; 53-week years differ by under 1 week
```
